emerging_technology: LLM-based autonomous AI agents: systems in which a large language model plans, calls external tools/APIs, observes results, and iterates toward a goal with limited human intervention.
intended_application: Draft social-media copy and event-theme ideas for human review before publication.
business_need: Increase ideation throughput and reduce time spent on first drafts.
users_stakeholders: Creative staff, account managers, clients, and agency leadership.
capabilities_constraints: Small team; lightweight tool stack; all external publication remains human-approved.
risk_consequence_context: Brand/reputation risk is present but outputs are reversible and reviewed before publication.
management_question: How much should the broad significance of LLM-based autonomous AI agents influence adoption of a low-consequence creative drafting workflow?
additional_context: General technology classification should remain separate from the local application decision.
